topic: T5b Postgres fix detail: pass railVersion to listHumanDecisions
lesson: Exact cause of the round-trip failure: T5b added a required railVersion input to repository.listHumanDecisions (eq(table.railVersion, input.railVersion)); the round-trip test calls it with only appId/agentFolder/actingPersonId while its records carry railVersion 4, so the query returns []. Fix the test call by passing railVersion: 4 (and any other listHumanDecisions call in that suite that omits it); do not loosen the repository filter. The FK failure in the audit test is separate: seed apps 'app-one' and 'app-two' before inserting permission_decisions rows.
